MECHANISM (code read, write order INFERRED from the notes): _netting_close_from_own_leg closed 6983 from its own leg (closed_by netting_own_leg_fill) with pnl NULL; _sweep_pending_pnl_from_bybit then called account_closed_pnl_for_trade, whose DEMO branch calls fills_pnl.exit_from_fills with closed_at_ms=None (window open to now) and takes close-side fills IN TIME ORDER until the qty is met, so 9178f2b1 alone (16239.2, within tolerance) won, and the sweep wrote exit_price 1.0836 over the own-leg price. FIX (Tier 2): in the demo branch use exit_from_one_order_fills with the row's sl/tp order ids and a bounded window, and never replace an exit_price whose exit_reason_source is venue_bracket_order; then backfill 6983 (exit 1.0629, pnl from it) and re-scan demo rows with notes own_leg_fill for the same overwrite (population not yet measured).
